summary.text: Jessie Seal is a Republican state senator from New Tazewell representing Tennessee Senate District 8 (Claiborne, Grainger, Hancock, Jefferson, Sevier and Union Counties), a member of the 114th General Assembly. He is second vice-chair of the Senate Energy, Agriculture, and Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Seal was born on January 9, 1991, and works as public relations director for LifeLine Ambulance Service.
In the Senate he also serves on the Government Operations and Transportation and Safety committees and on two joint committees.
